newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips jump to fourth straight record.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips jump to fourth straight record.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks set a record for the fourth consecutive session Wednesday.

According to early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 37 points to close at 7,576.27, a day after closing above 7,500 for the first time. The Nasdaq index reversed earlier losses to rise 6.10 points to 1,407.79.
